repurposing_rationale.mechanistic_link: Isoflurane 具缺血預處理效應（粒線體 K-ATP 通道 → PKC → adenosine），理論上可保護心肌免受缺血損傷。然而 Prinzmetal angina 病理核心為冠狀動脈痙攣，而 isoflurane 麻醉誘導/甦醒期的交感神經激活及已知 'coronary steal phenomenon' 實際上可能誘發或加劇血管痙攣，屬該族群的已知臨床顧慮而非治療效益。機轉連結矛盾，無任何臨床研究。
Tourette 症候群核心病理為紋狀體–丘腦–皮層迴路中 dopaminergic/GABAergic 失衡。Isoflurane 的 GABA-A 增強在理論上可抑制多餘的皮層興奮，但作為吸入性麻醉劑根本無法應用於慢性神經精神疾患的門診管理。知識圖譜推論，無任何臨床前或臨床支持證據。

repurposing_rationale.mechanistic_link: 躁症的核心神經生物學特徵包含 glutamatergic overactivity 及 GABAergic 不足；isoflurane 透過 NMDA 拮抗及 GABA-A 增強可大幅降低神經元過度興奮。1990 年代有研究者探索以 isoflurane 誘導 burst-suppression（腦電爆發抑制）作為 ECT 替代方案用於難治性情感疾患，機轉與 ketamine 用於抑鬱症類似（同為 NMDA 拮抗）。惟此機轉在臨床上已有30年以上無進展，且給藥方式之可行性極低。
拔毛症為 OCD 頻譜疾患，涉及 serotonin/glutamate/dopamine 多路徑失調。Isoflurane 的 NMDA 拮抗及 GABA-A 增強在 OCD 頻譜疾患有理論上的邊際相關性，但無任何臨床或臨床前研究，TxGNN 高分（0.9954）應反映知識圖譜的結構性類似性推論，而非真實治療潛力。
持續性憂鬱疾患可能涉及 NMDA 受體慢性過度活化及 GABAergic 功能不足。Isoflurane 的 NMDA 拮抗機轉與 ketamine 快速抗憂鬱效應相近，但 ketamine 在此領域已有大量 Phase 3 RCT 資料，isoflurane 完全無臨床探索紀錄。吸入性給藥方式及安全性疑慮進一步排除長期應用可能性。
NSIAD 為 AVPR2（V2 vasopressin receptor）功能獲得性突變，導致 ADH 非依賴性持續性水分再吸收及稀釋性低鈉血症。Isoflurane 可雙向影響 ADH 分泌，但無法針對 AVPR2 突變的病理機制產生治療效益。反之，isoflurane 代謝產物無機氟離子具腎毒性，對需謹慎腎功能管理的 NSIAD 患者存在額外風險。機轉連結不成立。

literature.title: Effects of passive smoking on cortical spreading depolarization in male and female mice.
literature.journal: The journal of headache and pain
literature.abstract: Patients with migraine are typically advised to avoid passive smoking because it may aggravate headaches and other health conditions. However, there is insufficient high-quality evidence on the association between passive smoking and migraine, which warrants further investigation using animal models. Therefore, using a mouse model, we examined the effect of passive smoking on susceptibility to cortical spreading depolarization (CSD), the biological basis of migraine with aura.

literature.title: Small-molecule CGRP antagonist atogepant does not affect cortical spreading depression susceptibility in rats.
literature.journal: The journal of headache and pain
literature.abstract: Atogepant is a small-molecule non-competitive calcitonin gene-related peptide (CGRP) receptor antagonist efficacious in preventing episodic migraine. Cortical spreading depolarization (CSD) is a slowly propagating depolarization wave underlying migraine aura. We investigated whether the efficacy of atogepant in migraine is mediated by CSD suppression.

literature.title: Increase in CGRP- and nNOS-immunoreactive neurons in the rat trigeminal ganglion after infusion of an NO donor.
literature.journal: Cephalalgia : an international journal of headache
literature.abstract: Nitrovasodilators, such as glyceroltrinitrate (GTN), which produce nitric oxide (NO) in the organism, are known to cause delayed headaches in migraineurs, accompanied by increased plasma levels of calcitonin gene-related peptide (CGRP) in the cranial venous outflow. Increases in plasma CGRP and NO metabolites have also been found in spontaneous migraine attacks. In a rat model of meningeal nociception, infusion of NO donors induced activity of neurons in the spinal trigeminal nucleus.

literature.title: Upregulation of inflammatory gene transcripts in periosteum of chronic migraineurs: Implications for extracranial origin of headache.
literature.journal: Annals of neurology
literature.abstract: Chronic migraine (CM) is often associated with chronic tenderness of pericranial muscles. A distinct increase in muscle tenderness prior to onset of occipital headache that eventually progresses into a full-blown migraine attack is common. This experience raises the possibility that some CM attacks originate outside the cranium. The objective of this study was to determine whether there are extracranial pathophysiologies in these headaches.

repurposing_rationale.mechanistic_link: Isoflurane 在動物模型中被充分證實可劑量依賴性地抑制皮層擴散去極化（cortical spreading depression, CSD）——偏頭痛先兆的電生理基礎及偏頭痛頭痛期觸發的核心機制。主要機轉：① NMDA 受體拮抗阻斷 CSD 傳播（細胞外 K⁺ 累積需 NMDA 活化才能持續）；② GABA-A 增強穩定神經元膜電位閾值；③ 兩孔鉀通道活化增加靜息膜電導。臨床層面：難治性偏頭痛持續狀態（status migrainosus）已有個案報告使用全身麻醉成功中止發作，且 PMID 20974582 顯示 isoflurane 輸注可改變三叉神經節 CGRP/nNOS 表達——直接涉及偏頭痛三叉血管路徑。主要障礙：需住院吸入給藥，長期使用之肝腎毒性，MH 觸發風險。急性難治性偏頭痛/status migrainosus 的短期住院搶救性應用或有一定探索空間。
肌筋膜疼痛症候群的機制涵蓋局部肌肉缺血、激痛點（trigger points）形成及中樞敏化。Isoflurane 的肌肉鬆弛（骨骼肌鬆弛輔助作用）及中樞神經廣泛抑制理論上可暫時緩解症狀，但此為所有全身麻醉藥物的共有非特異性效應，且無任何研究支持長期疼痛管理應用。

literature.title: Cortical spreading depression induces propagating activation of the thalamus ventral posteromedial nucleus in awake mice.
literature.journal: The journal of headache and pain
literature.abstract: As the relay centre for processing sensory information, the thalamus may involve in the abnormal sensory procedure caused by cortical spreading depression (CSD). However, few studies have focused on the transient response of thalamus during CSD. Our study aimed to investigate the neuronal activity of mouse thalamus ventral posteromedial nucleus (VPM) during CSD by in vivo micro-endoscopic fluorescence imaging of the genetic calcium probe GCaMP6s expressed in excitatory glutamatergic neurons.

repurposing_rationale.mechanistic_link: 腦幹先兆偏頭痛（原稱基底型偏頭痛）的病理涉及 CSD 波及後顱窩及腦幹結構，觸發腦幹特異性症狀（眩暈、複視、構音障礙、意識改變）。Isoflurane 的 CSD 抑制機轉與偏頭痛相同且適用，PMID 18501348 提供了 isoflurane 濃度依賴性抑制 CSD 的量效關係數據。此外，PMID 35073844 顯示 CSD 誘發丘腦 VPM 核的活化，而 isoflurane 的全腦性神經抑制可能對此腦幹-丘腦傳導路徑有額外的緩解效應。惟此為偏頭痛中少見且高度特殊的亞型（被排除在多數 triptans 試驗之外），臨床開發難度高於一般偏頭痛。
肌炎纖維化為罕見的骨骼肌炎症性纖維化病變，isoflurane 無已知的抗纖維化或抗炎症機轉。特別需注意的是，isoflurane 為惡性高熱（malignant hyperthermia）的已知觸發藥物，而 MH 的病理機制涉及骨骼肌 RYR1 受體異常（常見於肌肉疾患族群），使其在骨骼肌病變患者中存在實質安全疑慮，應列為相對禁忌。
